customManagers.description: Every pinned version in versions.yaml. The `# renovate:` comment above a line says where to look it up.

packageRules.description: Patch releases of Python, Node and Go: a pull request every Monday. The agent pipeline reviews it, builds every image on it, and merges it when all checks pass. Renovate itself merges nothing.
A new minor or major of a runtime is a decision, not a routine bump: nothing is opened until it is approved on the Dependency Dashboard issue.
Node: even majors only (LTS). An odd release is never a production base.
The Debian snapshot the rootfs layers are cut from. Weekly rebuilds already pick up security updates; this moves the pinned snapshot forward.
GitHub Actions: pinned by digest, one grouped pull request.
Dockerfile FROM lines that use build args are resolved from versions.yaml, not here.
